benefit_text: The scheme gives financial assistance of ₹ 1,20,000 per unit in plain areas and ₹ 1,30,000 per unit in hilly, difficult and IAP districts. It also provides a loan of up to ₹ 70,000 at 3% lower interest and a subsidy up to ₹ 2,00,000.
who_can_apply: Households without shelter, destitute families, manual scavengers, Primitive Tribal Groups and legally released bonded laborers are included. The scheme targets houseless families and those living in zero, one or two room kutcha houses. No age or income limits are mentioned.
documents: Aadhaar number with self‑attested copy, Job Card from MGNREGA, bank account details, Swachh Bharat Mission number and an affidavit stating no pucca house are required.
how_to_apply: Visit the official PMAY‑G website, log in and fill personal and bank details. Upload the Aadhaar consent form, then enter the job card and Swachh Bharat numbers. Submit the form to register.
